sources.name: Computer Forensic Reference Data Sets (CFReDS)
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

rights.license_expression: case-specific; NIST and contributed datasets coexist
rights.review_notes: Only acquire a selected CFReDS case after confirming that case's producer and terms; the portal includes both NIST-produced and contributed images.

truth.basis: Documented simulated digital evidence with known artifact placement for qualifying reference sets.
limitations: Truth strength and rights can vary for contributed datasets.

seed_selections.label: NIST-authored investigation-style reference sets
seed_selections.selection_method: Manual rights-qualified selection of documented simulated evidence sets with explicit planted artifacts and investigative questions.
seed_selections.notes: Do not infer that every portal item is NIST-authored or redistributable.

rights.license_expression: CC0 for original metadata/scenario material; embedded third-party content excluded
rights.review_notes: Original scenario data and metadata are generally CC0, but disk images, packet dumps and other artifacts can contain copyrighted third-party material. Preserve artifact-level rights metadata.

truth.basis: Synthetic or staged forensic scenarios with creator-known activity and evidence.
limitations: Scenario documentation quality varies by corpus.

seed_selections.label: Evidence-rich staged forensic investigations
seed_selections.selection_method: Select complete staged scenarios with warrants/reports plus multiple forensic modalities; rights-review each binary artifact separately.
seed_selections.notes: Scenario metadata may be redistributed separately from restricted embedded content.

rights.license_expression: U.S. government public-use dataset; docket attachments require separate rights review
rights.review_notes: The structured census is published for public use. Treat third-party material in accident dockets separately and preserve NTSB attribution.

truth.basis: Structured investigation records plus final factual findings and probable-cause determinations for closed cases.
limitations: Probable-cause findings are authoritative investigative conclusions, not metaphysical ground truth.

artifacts.label: Aviation census, 1982-present, August 2026 release
artifacts.notes: August 2026 release. The current NTSB directory serves avall.zip through FileDirectory/DownloadFile; the verified acquisition hash is recorded in docs/investigation_data/verified_artifacts.json. NTSB plans to transition bulk retrieval to its Enterprise API in April 2027.

seed_selections.label: Closed evidence-rich aviation investigations
seed_selections.selection_method: From the pinned census snapshot, filter to closed 2010-2024 investigations with a final probable cause and sufficient docket evidence; stratify by operation/event/cause; select deterministically by SHA-256(case_id + catalog_version).
seed_selections.notes: Docket evidence acquisition is a second gate because attachments may have separate rights and privacy considerations.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR filings and Accounting and Auditing Enforcement Releases

rights.license_expression: U.S. government public records with possible third-party exhibits/content
rights.review_notes: Acquire through SEC-supported APIs and respect fair-access/user-agent requirements. Review third-party exhibits before redistribution.

truth.basis: Time-ordered company filings can be paired with later complaints, orders, settlements and adjudicated enforcement findings.
limitations: Allegations and settlements must not be relabeled as proven ground truth.

artifacts.label: EDGAR submissions/XBRL REST API
artifacts.notes: Use source-specific API ingestion; no authentication key is required.

seed_selections.label: Closed accounting/enforcement investigations with pre-enforcement filings
seed_selections.selection_method: Select closed AAER matters across 2010-2025 where pre-enforcement EDGAR filings provide at least four chronological evidence points; stratify by accounting issue and outcome; deterministic hash selection within strata.
seed_selections.notes: Keep allegations, admitted facts, judicial findings and settlements as distinct finding types.

rights.review_notes: Retain dataset version and required citations in every derived episode manifest.

truth.basis: Systematically coded conflict events with source-evaluation methodology; useful as observed world-state evidence rather than hidden causal truth.
limitations: Event coding is evidence, not a complete account of intent, attribution or causality.

artifacts.label: GED Global 26.1 CSV archive
artifacts.notes: Pin the downloaded archive hash and codebook version.

seed_selections.label: Conflict event context for retrospective crisis episodes
seed_selections.selection_method: Use UCDP as an event/context layer for post-1989 retrospective crisis episodes; do not use UCDP-coded events as sole verifier truth.
seed_selections.notes: Pair with declassified/official documentary sources where available.

sources.name: Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS) ebook catalog
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian

rights.license_expression: official U.S. government documentary series; preserve document-level provenance
rights.review_notes: The public API exposes free ebook catalog/download links. Preserve document provenance and review any document-specific third-party rights if encountered.

truth.basis: Declassified primary-source diplomatic records published as the official documentary history of major U.S. foreign-policy decisions.
limitations: Documentary record is selective and may reflect institutional perspective; later documents can leak outcomes into earlier decision points.

artifacts.label: FRUS OPDS catalog API
artifacts.notes: Ingest catalog metadata first, then pin selected volumes/documents.

seed_selections.label: Retrospective high-stakes diplomatic and military crises
seed_selections.selection_method: Select crises with dense pre-decision primary sources and later documentary resolution. Cut each episode at a historical decision timestamp and seal all later documents from the public state.
seed_selections.notes: Later documentary evidence may support the private evaluator but must never appear in the agent-visible package before its simulated availability time.

rights.license_expression: copyright and related rights waived to the extent possible under law
rights.review_notes: Dataset is de-identified and public-release approved; retain required citation and source version. Download is form-mediated.

truth.basis: 58 days of multi-source enterprise telemetry with explicit red-team compromise events supplied as bad-behavior ground truth.
limitations: Red-team event list is ground truth for known injected activity, not necessarily an exhaustive label for every anomalous event.

artifacts.label: Known red-team events
artifacts.notes: Acquire through LANL's usage form. Small ground-truth file can be acquired before the multi-gigabyte telemetry.

seed_selections.label: Red-team-centered incident investigations
seed_selections.selection_method: Center bounded temporal windows around known red-team events, then include only telemetry available by each simulated step. Create hard negatives from matched windows without listed red-team events while retaining UNKNOWN for unlabeled malicious activity.
seed_selections.notes: Acquire the 4.8K red-team truth file first; stream or remotely slice larger telemetry instead of copying all 12 GB into the repository.

sources.name: U.S. Chemical Safety Board investigations
sources.publisher: U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board

rights.license_expression: U.S. government investigation materials; review embedded third-party media separately
rights.review_notes: Prefer final reports and public factual materials. Review photographs/video/attachments for third-party rights before redistribution.

truth.basis: Independent federal root-cause investigations with evidence, findings and safety recommendations.
limitations: Root-cause findings remain investigative conclusions and should be represented separately from directly established facts.

seed_selections.label: Completed industrial root-cause investigations
seed_selections.selection_method: Select completed investigations with final reports, rich timelines, multiple causal contributors and sufficient public evidence; stratify by failure mechanism.
seed_selections.notes: Use videos as augmentation only after report-grounded episode construction.

sources.name: CDC National Outbreak Reporting System public dataset
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

rights.license_expression: Public Domain U.S. Government for the public NORS dataset; artifact-scoped CDC attribution and non-endorsement conditions apply
rights.review_notes: Approval is limited to the public NORS dataset identified as data.cdc.gov asset 5xkq-dg7x. Redistribution requires review because CDC conditions exceed attribution alone: preserve CDC attribution, include a prominent non-endorsement disclaimer, do not substantively alter the material, and state that the material is available from CDC at no charge. Do not extend this policy to additional NORS requests, third-party media, or underlying state/local records without separate review.

truth.basis: CDC-published outbreak surveillance records reported by state, local and territorial health departments and subjected to CDC data-quality close-out before public release.
limitations: NORS is dynamic and historical reports can be revised after close-out.
The public dataset is not a substitute for case-level investigative records.

artifacts.label: NORS public-use dataset 5xkq-dg7x
artifacts.notes: Use the official Data.CDC.gov API/export surface. Pin the dataset asset ID, export timestamp, row/column metadata and acquired content hash; do not treat later revisions as contemporaneous evidence.

seed_selections.label: Public outbreak surveillance context
seed_selections.selection_method: Select closed-out public rows with sufficient temporal and etiologic fields, stratify by transmission mode and setting, and pair with independently rights-reviewed case evidence before constructing an investigation episode.
seed_selections.notes: Use NORS as context and case-selection evidence only; never infer hidden facility/person identity or causal ground truth from the public aggregate record.

rights.license_expression: Public Coast Guard information with explicit non-commercial/non-endorsement constraints; AI/training and commercial redistribution not expressly authorized
rights.review_notes: CGMIX explicitly provides public bulk IIR export, so acquisition of that public export is approved. Coast Guard web policy restricts commercial use and does not establish AI/training permission; redistribution and AI use therefore remain review-required. Do not extend this approval to FOIA-only complete reports or linked third-party material.

truth.basis: Closed reportable marine-casualty investigations published by the Coast Guard with incident, timeline and detail data.
limitations: The Coast Guard disclaims guarantees of accuracy, completeness and timeliness.
Published IIR data are disclosure-filtered and are not necessarily the complete investigative file.
Cases closed after October 2002 can have incident start dates years earlier.

artifacts.label: CGMIX closed-investigation XLSX export
artifacts.notes: Record the exact export query, activity IDs, export date, CGMIX last-update date and acquired content hash. The policy lane performs no export or download.

seed_selections.label: Closed reportable marine-casualty investigations
seed_selections.selection_method: Select closed IIR records with sufficient incident/timeline/detail evidence, stratify by casualty mechanism, and preserve Activity ID plus export snapshot provenance for every selected record.
seed_selections.notes: Rights approval covers acquisition of the public CGMIX export only. Any derived training or redistributable package remains blocked pending a separate rights review.

rights.license_expression: ACLED EULA; corporate license required for commercial entities and AI/ML use is restricted
rights.review_notes: Do not acquire or use for Veritas training/evaluation without a separately reviewed license that expressly permits the intended AI and commercial use. Use UCDP for the default open conflict-data lane.

truth.basis: Conflict event coding; cataloged only to record a deliberate exclusion decision.
limitations: Blocked by source-use policy for this project.
